text: In 1980, an oil rig made a whole lake disappear. Under the lake was a salt mine. The drill was supposed to miss it. It did not miss it. Water poured in and dissolved the salt pillars, which made the hole bigger, which let in more water. The lake drained like a bathtub. The canal ran backwards into a brand-new waterfall. Eleven barges and the drilling rig got sucked down. All fifty-five miners got out alive. The lake came back. Salty. Measure twice. Drill once.
